descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience in Erstfeld, from now on or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103356 Christian Diener Telephone +41 79 505 05 94 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Auf dich wartet ein spannendes, innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du grosse Veränderungen antreiben kannst und so zur Digitalisierung der SBB beiträgst. Im Werk Olten arbeitest du aktuell im Zweischichtbetrieb von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 04.45 Uhr und 17.45 Uhr.

Macchinista: in manovra o specialista in manovra: a Olten, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Vi aspetta un ambiente di lavoro entusiasmante e innovativo in cui potrete guidare grandi cambiamenti e contribuire così alla digitalizzazione delle FFS. In UHR (manutenzione materiale rotabile) avrai una posizione chiave nello stabilimento di Olten, con molti compiti e responsabilità per supportare i nostri clienti con il tuo pieno impegno. Anche la formazione continua non viene trascurata per lo sviluppo professionale individuale. Nello stabilimento di Olten attualmente lavorate su due turni dal lunedì al venerdì dalle 4:45 alle 17:45. Lavorate nel rispetto delle prescrizioni del servizio di trasporto e degli standard prescritti dalle FFS. - Anche la messa in servizio e la guida di più unità e treni articolati rientrano nella vostra area di responsabilità. - Guidi locomotive da manovra, veicoli strada-rotaia, effettui prove di frenata e ti assicuri che siano pronti per la guida. Sei anche responsabile della piccola manutenzione dei veicoli. - La soddisfazione del cliente è uno dei nostri obiettivi principali. Lavori per i nostri clienti ogni giorno. Vivi la nostra cultura della sicurezza e applichi costantemente il processo di miglioramento continuo (CIP). descriptionByLocale.en: Train driver: in shunting or shunting specialist: in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Train driver: in shunting or shunting specialist: in Olten, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. An exciting, innovative working environment awaits you in which you can drive big changes and thus contribute to the digitalization of SBB. At UHR (maintenance rolling stock) you will have a key position in the Olten plant, with many tasks and responsibilities in order to support our customers with your full commitment. Together with your teammates, you will develop solutions to current challenges and implement them as a team. Further training is also not neglected for individual professional development. At the Olten plant you are currently working in two shifts from Monday to Friday between 4:45 a.m. and 5:45 p.m. You can move that. - As a shunting specialist, you move passenger and freight train cars under the guidance of the maneuver coordinator. - Your area of ​​activity includes, among other things, attaching and detaching the various wagons and operating the manual switches and the signal box. You work in accordance with the transport service regulations and the prescribed standards of the SBB. - Commissioning and driving multiple units and articulated trains are also part of your area of ​​responsibility. - You drive shunting locomotives, road-rail vehicles, carry out brake tests and ensure that they are ready to drive. You are also responsible for the small maintenance of the vehicles. - Customer satisfaction is one of our top goals. You work for our customers every day. You live our safety culture and constantly apply the continuous improvement process (CIP). This is what you bring with you. - In order for you to be able to carry out this responsible task successfully, you must be mentally and physically fit and in good shape. - You are characterized by your networked thinking and actions, your resilience, your independence and your willingness to take responsibility. - Strong team play as well as an above-average customer and quality orientation are further attributes that describe your character well. - For the demanding position, you need to have completed basic EFZ training, ideally as a logistics specialist in transport or similar training in a craft/technical direction. - Ideally, you have training and experience in shunting, combined with driving accompaniment in accordance with the BAV ID card VTE A40 direct. Alternatively, you are an Ai40 shunting attendant indirectly and are willing to take part in VTE A40 training. - You have good written and oral language skills in German (at least level B2). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103360 Erich Huser Telephone +41 79 894 00 43 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Conducteur de train : en manœuvres ou spécialiste des manœuvres : à Olten, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100 % Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Un environnement de travail passionnant et innovant vous attend dans lequel vous pouvez conduire de grands changements et ainsi contribuer à la numérisation des CFF. Chez UHR (maintenance du matériel roulant), vous occuperez un poste clé au sein de l'usine d'Olten, avec de nombreuses tâches et responsabilités afin d'accompagner nos clients avec votre plein engagement. Avec vos coéquipiers, vous développerez des solutions aux défis actuels et les mettrez en œuvre en équipe. La formation continue n’est pas non plus négligée pour le développement professionnel individuel. À l'usine d'Olten, vous travaillez actuellement en deux équipes du lundi au vendredi entre 4h45 et 17h45. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que spécialiste des manœuvres, vous déplacez des wagons de voyageurs et de marchandises sous la direction du coordonnateur des manœuvres. - Votre domaine d'activité comprend entre autres l'attelage et le détachement des différents wagons ainsi que la manoeuvre des interrupteurs manuels et du poste de signalisation. Vous travaillez conformément aux prescriptions relatives aux services de transport et aux normes prescrites par les CFF. - La mise en service et la conduite d'unités multiples et de trains articulés font également partie de votre domaine de responsabilité. - Vous conduisez des locomotives de manœuvre, des véhicules rail-route, effectuez des tests de freinage et vous assurez qu'ils sont prêts à rouler. Vous êtes également responsable du petit entretien des véhicules. - La satisfaction du client est l'un de nos principaux objectifs. Vous travaillez chaque jour pour nos clients. Vous vivez notre culture de sécurité et appliquez constamment le processus d’amélioration continue (CIP). descriptionByLocale.en: Shift manager: in transport 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shift manager: in Transport Oensingen, September 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck trips per day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you and your teammates will move SBB Cargo forward. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As a shift leader, you are responsible for operational management during the shift assigned to you and represent the team leader during this time. - In the team you are responsible for the operational management of personnel, trains and vehicles. You make functional instructions and assign them as needed to the group that is your area of ​​responsibility. - You ensure that safety rules and processes, as well as punctuality and safety, are adhered to when preparing trains in your area. - If there are deviations, you will take action independently to keep the impact on customers and operations as low as possible. - You represent the interests of SBB Cargo in the event of an incident. Based on your observations, you provide important information on how to improve processes and the use of resources. This is what you bring with you. - You enjoy working in a team and respect different personalities, you work independently and quickly find a good solution, even in difficult situations. You are actively committed to the safety of your colleagues and are a role model in everyday life. - You have comprehensive social and professional skills. You value making decisions in unforeseen situations. - Completed vocational training or several years of professional experience in the field of shunting as well as a good command of the local language are required. - A secure use of Office 365 is a matter of course for you, as is the application of the working time regulations of the GAV and the AZG. - You have a lot of experience in maneuvering. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level G, regional allowance level No regional allowance. More about pay and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103071 Rico Lohse, team leader Telephone +41 79 687 12 65 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Rund 14 000 Mitarbeitende des Personenverkehrs sorgen dafür, dass die über 1,4 Mio. Kundinnen und Kunden der SBB, welche wir täglich befördern, einen einfachen Zugang zum Öffentlichen Verkehr erhalten und sowohl sicher als auch pünktlich von A nach B reisen. Das Rangierpersonal als zentrale Berufsgruppe leistet dafür einen zentralen Beitrag. Auf dich wartet ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen die SBB bewegst, sowie eine abwechslungsreiche und bezahlte Ausbildung. Zudem hast du verschiedene interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Für Nachteinsätze erhältst du zusätzlich Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30 %. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Du bereitest Personenzüge auf ihre Fahrt vor und bewegst sie im Bahnhof sowie in dessen Umgebung (bis max. 40 km/h) an den richtigen Ausgangsort.
- Dabei stellst du Züge zusammen, trennst einzelne Wagen und sorgst dafür, dass alles am richtigen Platz ist.
- Du machst den Zug startklar, überprüfst die wichtigsten Funktionen und führst Bremskontrollen durch.
- Während deiner Arbeit behältst du den Überblick und sorgst dafür, dass alle Abläufe sicher und reibungslos funktionieren.
- Kleinere Störungen behebst du selbstständig oder meldest sie an die zuständige Stelle weiter.
Hier erfährst du mehr zum Berufsbild.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist aufmerksam, konzentriert und körperlich belastbar, um diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb erfolgreich zu bewältigen. Ausserdem arbeitest du gerne bei jedem Wetter draussen.
- Da sämtliche Anweisungen und Dokumentationen elektronisch sind, wirst du dich schnell mit digitalen Hilfsmitteln zurechtfinden.
- Du hast eine abgeschlossene Grundbildung (mind. EBA) und bringst bereits praktische Erfahrung mit – idealerweise aus einem handwerklichen oder logistischen Umfeld.
- In Deutsch bringst du in Wort und Schrift sehr gute Kenntnisse (Niveau B2) mit.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot- / Grünschwäche)

Circa 14'000 collaboratori del trasporto passeggeri garantiscono che gli oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti delle FFS che trasportiamo ogni giorno abbiano un facile accesso ai trasporti pubblici e viaggino da A a B in modo sicuro e puntuale. In quanto gruppo professionale centrale, il personale di manovra fornisce un contributo fondamentale a questo scopo. Ti aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo, nel quale ti muoverai alle FFS insieme ai tuoi compagni di squadra, oltre a una formazione varia e retribuita. Lateral entry train driver: in shunting Winterthur, October 1st, 2026, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.4 million SBB customers we transport every day have easy access to public transport and travel from A to B both safely and on time. As a central professional group, the shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you will move SBB together with your teammates, as well as varied and paid training. You also have various internal training opportunities. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive additional time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - You prepare passenger trains for their journey and move them to the correct starting point in and around the station (up to a maximum of 40 km/h). - You put trains together, separate individual cars and make sure that everything is in the right place. - You get the train ready to go, check the most important functions and carry out brake checks. - During your work, you maintain an overview and ensure that all processes run safely and smoothly. - You can repair minor problems yourself or report them to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - You have completed basic education (at least EBA) and already have practical experience - ideally from a craft or logistics environment. - You have very good spoken and written knowledge of German (level B2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) ## Your salary and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Goldau, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. En tant que conducteur de train, vous faites de grandes choses : chez Transport de voyageurs CFF, vous transportez chaque année environ 482 millions de voyageurs. Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Vous amenez nos passagers à destination à temps et garantissez une expérience de voyage positive avec les CFF. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est également pleine de perspectives avec des conditions attractives pour toutes les situations de la vie. Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel trasporto passeggeri 03/2027 Zugo, 1 marzo 2027, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione per diventare macchinista, dopo aver consultato voi potete organizzare individualmente il vostro carico di lavoro a partire dal 60% e avete a disposizione diversi modelli di lavoro part-time. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista non assumi solo la guida del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla trafficata rete ferroviaria. - Durante il viaggio sii consapevole e reagisci rapidamente e correttamente ai segnali, ai controlli di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e di controllo. - Oltre alla guida e alla manovra dei treni, i tuoi compiti comprendono anche il controllo delle condizioni tecniche prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Aver completato un tirocinio triennale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ben ponderate anche in situazioni di stress e sei disposto a lavorare a turni. - Parli correntemente il tedesco (livello C2) e hai una conoscenza base del francese (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. - Hai molta responsabilità personale e motivazione per il periodo di formazione intenso ed impegnativo e sei disposto a essere coinvolto in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni in aula in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry as train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Zug, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Vuoi un lavoro in cui ogni mossa che fai conta? Alle FFS avete la possibilità di mettere a frutto le vostre competenze e allo stesso tempo di acquisirne di nuove che arricchiranno e faranno progredire la vostra carriera. Hai completato un apprendistato nel settore meccanico e artigianale e vorresti fare la differenza in un ambiente lavorativo stimolante e innovativo? Allora sei nel posto giusto!
• Cerchiamo supporto in queste località della Svizzera tedesca: Zurigo, Brugg, Rapperswil e Winterthur. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Puoi allenarti nel centro fitness durante la settimana, goderti il ​​sole in piscina, fare shopping senza fare la fila: rendi semplicemente più flessibile il tuo tempo libero. Paghiamo un compenso aggiuntivo per il lavoro di guardia, notturno e nei fine settimana. A seconda degli incarichi paghiamo un supplemento tra 300 e 700 CHF al mese. Riceverai anche bonus di tempo del 10-30%. Ciò significa che puoi compensare queste indennità di tempo con tempo libero. Gli altri nostri vantaggi come gli assegni per i figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Le macchine grandi e moderne ti entusiasmano tanto quanto i compiti responsabili e complessi. - Nel tuo nuovo ruolo, a seconda delle tue qualifiche e competenze, sarai responsabile della costruzione, manutenzione e riparazione di sistemi ferroviari come linee aeree, binari, scambi, barriere, segnali o sistemi di protezione dei treni. Questo è un annuncio di pool per tutte le posizioni nell'area sopra menzionata. In base alle tue competenze, esperienza e formazione determineremo l'opportunità di ingresso più adatta a te. Police officer: in transport police base Zurich, July 1st, 2025 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. For our base in Zurich, we are looking for committed and motivated police officers who would like to dedicate themselves to an exciting and varied position. For us, the focus is not on office work, but on community policing at the pulse of what is happening in public transport with a clear focus on security police tasks. We also work regularly with other police forces and partner organizations, which will expand your network. Become part of an appreciative, dynamic and motivated team that ensures security and order beyond the canton's borders. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - As a police officer in the SBB transport police, you and over 190 colleagues will ensure safety, peace and order in the train stations and on public transport from various transport companies. - You provide a uniformed and civilian presence in means of transport, in train stations and on the premises of the transport companies. - You contribute to the protection and safety of our travelers and public transport staff. - With police interventions, also together with partner organizations, you take responsibility for security and order. - The exciting challenges also include deployments in event trains and at major events in the Swiss operational area. This is what you bring with you. - You are a service-oriented, open and winning personality, as you are in daily contact with our customers. - For us, teamwork is the key to success. You are a team player and look forward to working together as a team. - You have the federal police officer I certificate and have good police tactical and technical knowledge. - You are characterized by very good oral and written expression in the German language. Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. - You also have good IT and administrative knowledge, which you can use in a goal-oriented manner. ## Your salary and your benefits. descriptionByLocale.en: Chief fitter: in contact line 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Chief fitter in German-speaking Switzerland, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you can initiate major changes and thus contribute to the success of SBB. Together with your teammates, you will develop solutions to current challenges and implement them as a team. Further training is also not neglected for your individual development. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. But you can enjoy free ski slopes during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. You will also receive time allowances. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - Together with the team, you carry out the demanding maintenance and renewal work as well as troubleshooting on our contact line systems. - You will be in charge of operations during construction, maintenance and repair work on the contact line systems. - In order to ensure the reliability and safety of the contact line systems economically, you lay our contact wires and support cables professionally. You will operate specialized equipment on the overhead line assembly machines on the respective vehicles with lifting, pulling and crane functions. - You lead employees professionally, lead work assignments and monitor the correct execution of the work and compliance with safety measures on the construction sites. This is what you bring with you. - You have a high level of resilience and a high level of safety awareness for this exciting challenge. We also place great value on the ability to work in a team and work independently. - You have a certificate of competence in the electrical or construction industry and have several years of experience in overhead line construction including switching authorization and expertise. - Good PC and user knowledge (MS Office, TUSP etc.) will make your work easier. You have already demonstrated your experience in planning (AVOR 3) and implementing construction sites. - You don't mind irregular working hours and on-call shifts and can communicate very well in German. Ideally, you have a driver's license of category A40 or higher, as well as a driver's license of category B. ## Your salary and benefits. Non esageri quando dici che senza di te la Svizzera è ferma! In qualità di caposquadra vi assicurate che il traffico ferroviario si svolga senza intoppi nell'area operativa della filiale. Ma puoi goderti le piscine vuote durante la settimana e organizzare il tuo tempo libero in modo più flessibile. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Riceverai anche indennità di tempo. Foreman: in track construction in German-speaking Switzerland, from now on or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB you have the chance to use your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that will enrich and advance your career. You're not exaggerating when you say that Switzerland stands still without you! As a foreman, you ensure that rail traffic runs smoothly in the branch's operational area. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. But you can enjoy empty swimming pools during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. You will also receive time allowances. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - In this role you are responsible for maintenance work, superficial and civil engineering work in the roadway area. - Monitoring the correct execution of the work and compliance with safety measures is your responsibility. - You take over the management of several construction sites and the technical management of the employees. - The team also supports work preparation and reporting. This is what you bring with you. - You are independent, a team player and resilient and like to lend a hand. - You have good health with unrestricted hearing and vision. - A vocational apprenticeship as a traffic route builder or a vocational apprenticeship recognized by the SERI with a craft orientation (three years) and EFZ is a prerequisite, as well as the potential and willingness to further train as a foreman. We require that you be willing to work irregular hours and be on call for this position. You have also successfully completed further training as a foreman in track construction and are head of safety RTE 20100. - You have a driving license category B., a valid driving license category E (trailer) is an advantage. ## Your salary and your benefits. Contremaître : dans la construction de voies ferrées en Suisse alémanique, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60 à 100 % Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Chez CFF, vous avez la possibilité d'utiliser vos compétences tout en acquérant de nouvelles compétences qui enrichiront et feront progresser votre carrière. Vous n'exagérez pas lorsque vous dites que la Suisse reste immobile sans vous ! En tant que contremaître, vous veillez au bon déroulement du trafic ferroviaire dans la zone d'exploitation de la succursale. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Mais vous pouvez profiter de piscines vides en semaine et organiser votre temps libre de manière plus flexible. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Vous recevrez également des allocations de temps. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Dans ce rôle, vous êtes responsable des travaux d'entretien, des travaux de génie civil et superficiel dans le domaine routier. - Le contrôle de la bonne exécution des travaux et du respect des mesures de sécurité relève de votre responsabilité. - Vous prenez en charge la direction de plusieurs chantiers et la gestion technique des collaborateurs. - L'équipe prend également en charge la préparation du travail et le reporting. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes indépendant, joueur d'équipe et résilient et aimez donner un coup de main. - Vous êtes en bonne santé et disposez d'une audition et d'une vision sans restriction. - Un apprentissage professionnel de constructeur de voies de circulation ou un apprentissage professionnel reconnu par le SEFRI avec orientation artisanale (trois ans) et EFZ est une condition préalable, ainsi que le potentiel et la volonté de se perfectionner en tant que contremaître. Nous exigeons que vous soyez prêt à travailler selon des horaires irréguliers et que vous soyez de garde pour ce poste. Vous avez également suivi avec succès une formation continue de contremaître en construction de voies et êtes responsable de la sécurité RTE 20100. - Vous disposez d'un permis de conduire catégorie B., un permis de conduire valide catégorie E (remorque) est un avantage. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Attendi con ansia lavori entusiasmanti e vari come artigiano e macchinista ed entra a far parte di un team di famiglia. In questo lavoro combini competenze tecniche con consapevolezza della sicurezza e talento organizzativo. Sei ambizioso? Con noi hai l'opportunità di svilupparti continuamente e acquisire nuove competenze. This is what you bring with you. - Reliability is what sets you apart and is reflected in punctuality, quality and safety awareness. - You are physically and mentally resilient for this demanding work and enjoy working outside in any weather. - You have completed basic training with EFZ, ideally in the area of ​​traffic logistics or have already gained experience as a shunter or train driver in the past. - You have a valid BAV ID card for train drivers in category A40 according to VTE or are willing to obtain one. - Good knowledge of German (at least level B2) both spoken and written rounds off your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. Guardiano di sicurezza con ingresso laterale / capo della sicurezza Winterthur, da ora in poi o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di guardia di sicurezza, ti assicuri che i lavori nell'area della pista siano svolti in sicurezza e nel rispetto delle misure di sicurezza. La vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è tanto varia quanto i vostri orari di lavoro e i diversi luoghi in cui viaggiate lungo le più belle tratte ferroviarie della Svizzera. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni riceverete anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi spostarlo. - Sei responsabile della protezione del personale, dei materiali e delle attrezzature dai pericoli delle operazioni ferroviarie e dei sistemi di trazione. - In qualità di guardia di sicurezza, avverti i colleghi del cantiere ferroviario dell'avvicinarsi dei treni. - Sei responsabile della creazione e dell'implementazione di un sistema di sicurezza e della comunicazione diretta via telefono o radio con le autorità competenti. - Informare i responsabili del cantiere di eventuali incidenti insoliti rilevati nella loro area di attività. - Viaggi molto e svolgi questa attività in diverse località della tua regione. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry security guard / head of security 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry security guard / head of security Winterthur, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a safety guard, you ensure that work in the track area is carried out safely and in compliance with safety measures. Your everyday working life is just as varied as your working hours and the different locations you travel along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - You are responsible for protecting staff, materials and equipment from the dangers of railway operations and traction power systems. - As a security guard, you warn colleagues at the railway construction site about approaching trains. - You are responsible for setting up and implementing a security system and communicating directly by telephone or radio with the responsible authorities. - You inform those responsible for the construction site about any unusual incidents that have been identified in their area of ​​activity. - You travel a lot and carry out this activity at different locations in your region. More about the job description here. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are prepared to work independently, reliably, as a team player and openly, in shifts (early morning, day, night and weekend shifts). - You are physically and mentally resilient and have a strong sense of security. - Ideally, you have completed basic training (EBA / EFZ) or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. You have completed your training as a security guard or head of security or are ready to complete it. - You are skilled at using various digital work tools (iPad and iPhone) and applications and are willing to continually educate yourself and learn. - Your fluent German skills round off your profile. Knowledge of a second national language is desirable. - A valid category B driving license (passenger car with manual transmission) and good eyesight and hearing complete your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102856 Andreas Müller, team leader Telephone +41 79 894 01 98 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Agent de sécurité à entrée latérale / chef de la sécurité Winterthur, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. En tant qu'agent de sécurité, vous veillez à ce que les travaux dans la zone de la voie soient effectués en toute sécurité et dans le respect des mesures de sécurité. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est aussi variée que vos horaires de travail et les différents lieux que vous parcourez le long des plus beaux itinéraires ferroviaires de Suisse. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également de majorations de temps comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Vous êtes responsable de la protection du personnel, du matériel et des équipements contre les dangers de l'exploitation ferroviaire et des systèmes de traction. - En tant qu'agent de sécurité, vous avertissez vos collègues sur le chantier ferroviaire de l'approche des trains. - Vous êtes responsable de la mise en place et de la mise en œuvre d'un système de sécurité et de communiquer directement par téléphone ou radio avec les autorités responsables. - Vous informez les responsables du chantier de tout incident inhabituel qui aurait été identifié dans leur domaine d'activité. - Vous voyagez beaucoup et exercez cette activité à différents endroits de votre région. En savoir plus sur la description de poste ici. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce travail exigeant, vous êtes prêt à travailler de manière indépendante, fiable, en équipe et ouvertement, par équipes (tôt le matin, de jour, de nuit et de fin de semaine). - Vous êtes résilient physiquement et mentalement et possédez un fort sentiment de sécurité. - Idéalement, vous avez suivi une formation de base (EBA/EFZ) ou possédez déjà une expérience professionnelle dans l'artisanat, la logistique ou un domaine comparable. Macchinista con accesso laterale: in treno da costruzione con esperienza manuale Olten, 1 maggio 2026 o previo accordo, 100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Ti aspetta un programma di formazione a tempo pieno di 9 mesi vario e retribuito. Completate la vostra formazione teorica a Olten o Zurigo e fate la vostra prima esperienza pratica in uno scalo di smistamento assegnato a livello regionale. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. Puoi trovare vantaggi come AG gratuita, viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - sul nostro sito web alla voce Benefit e maggiori informazioni sul lavoro qui. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista di treni da cantiere, dai un grande contributo al rinnovamento dei percorsi (binari, ghiaia, ecc.). - Effettui ed effettui autonomamente vari e complessi movimenti di manovra di treni fino ad un massimo di 100 km/h, li allestisci e smonti e li prepari per il viaggio. - Per garantire la logistica regionale, redigete, richiedete e ordinate gli ordini di guida in tempo e siete responsabili della fornitura dei cantieri con i materiali necessari. - Hai un'elevata responsabilità per la sicurezza operativa dei treni da cantiere. Il controllo della sicurezza sul lavoro e la redazione di reportistica completano l'attività. - Inoltre, sarai impiegato come macchinista per i treni edili in cantiere e saranno richieste le tue competenze tecniche. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei coscienzioso, affidabile, un giocatore di squadra e disposto a lavorare su turni di 24 ore. - Sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente e puoi agire consapevolmente e correttamente con il tuo modo di lavorare indipendente. - Possiedi almeno due anni di formazione professionale riconosciuta comprensiva di un certificato di idoneità, preferibilmente nel settore edile e con esperienza nella costruzione di binari oppure hai completato il diploma di scuola superiore. - Prerequisito è la conoscenza della lingua tedesca scritta e parlata (livello C1). - Possiedi la patente di guida di categoria B. - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Olten, May 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and disassemble them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to 2 months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to 2 months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102713 Josip Aracic, team leader Telephone +41 79 586 17 10 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Ciò garantisce che i nostri clienti possano viaggiare con il massimo comfort possibile. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Nel nostro settore, il lavoro di squadra è la chiave del successo. La formazione come installatore di impianti di refrigerazione: in EFZ o simili è un grande vantaggio. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Technician: in air conditioning systems for the SBB fleet in Olten, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Grab the opportunity for your next development step. Make your contribution to a good climate and become an air conditioning technician at SBB. An open-minded and committed team looks forward to seeing you. Today, more than 7,800 air conditioning units are installed in over 4,600 vehicles (trains, passenger cars and locomotives). This corresponds to a coverage of around 94 percent. In our own “Climate Competence Center” you have around 2,400 m2 available just for refurbishing the air conditioning units. Together you will develop solutions to the current challenges and implement them as a team. You can find out more about this profession on our website. And if you would like to take a look around this department, you can do so here. Attractive working conditions are important to us. You can find our benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As an air conditioning technician for the SBB fleet, you will actively work on repairing, overhauling and testing the air conditioning systems for our fleets. This ensures that our customers can travel with the highest possible comfort. You also make your contribution to a good climate, especially on the train. - You independently operate the air conditioning test devices to carry out input and output tests as well as diagnoses on the air conditioning devices. - You are responsible for the refrigeration interventions of the air conditioning units and carry them out with high efficiency and quality. - With your extensive know-how, you enjoy supporting the team. This is what you bring with you. - In our industry, teamwork is the key to success. You are an absolute team player with the ability to work in an interdisciplinary manner. - You act proactively and enjoy working independently. You systematically plan your next work steps in advance. Your solution-oriented way of thinking and acting makes your work easier in our dynamic and challenging environment. - Very good technical understanding and experience in remanufacturing in an industrial production company are an advantage. - You have basic training in the mechanical or electromechanical field with an EFZ qualification. Training such as refrigeration system fitter: in EFZ or similar is a great advantage. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level F, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision no later than 4 weeks after receipt of application Application Final decision no later than 4 weeks after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102064 Mario Gazibaric Head of Climate Competence Center Telephone +41 79 529 98 50 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. Automation engineer, electrical engineer or electrical installer in the field of signal box technology Brugg AG, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. We will train you to become a specialist for complex electrical interlocking systems. In this way, you can make a significant contribution to ensuring that our customers have highly available and secure signaling and automation systems at all times. In internal training courses you will be intensively and professionally prepared for your future role. There is also the opportunity to continually develop yourself and take on tasks with more responsibility. An ambitious and motivated team is looking forward to a new team member. Attractive working conditions are important to us. You can find our benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - In your role, you independently carry out construction and maintenance activities on the railway electrical systems, primarily indoors. - You will be actively involved in economically ensuring the reliability, availability and safety of the railway infrastructure systems. - You provide on-call duty to resolve faults in the complex systems and ensure their availability. - Depending on the respective project, you will work sporadically at night and on weekends. Of course, these hours worked will also be rewarded accordingly. - So that you can successfully carry out this important function, you will undergo two years of part-time internal training. We train you so that you can independently locate and resolve faults in the indoor systems. This is what you bring with you. - You are a technically savvy personality, independent and proactive and are always flexible in your way of working for the tasks involved. - For this position you need a completed 4-year basic electrical engineering training EFZ (automatic engineer, electrical engineer, electrician or related professions). - The prerequisite for taking up the position is good hearing and vision so that you can recognize important acoustic and visual signals when working in the track area. - For this position you need a category B driving license. Ideally, you live in the Brugg region so that you can be at the location within around 30 minutes during on-call duty. - We expect very good oral and written German skills (B2-C2). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level F, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Für unseren Stützpunkt in St. Gallen suchen wir engagierte und motivierte Polizist:innen, die sich einer spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Stelle widmen möchten. Bei uns steht nicht die Büroarbeit im Vordergrund, sondern die bürgernahe Polizeiarbeit am Puls des Geschehens im öffentlichen Verkehr mit einem klaren Fokus auf die sicherheitspolizeilichen Aufgaben. Zudem arbeiten wir regelmässig mit anderen Polizeikräften und Partnerorganisationen zusammen, was dein Netzwerk erweitern wird. Werde Teil eines wertschätzenden, dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das über die Kantonsgrenzen hinaus für Sicherheit und Ordnung sorgt.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge von zwischen 10 und 30%. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.

- Du leistest uniformierte und auch zivile Präsenz in Transportmitteln, in Bahnhöfen und auf dem Areal der Transportunternehmen.
- Dabei trägst du zum Schutz und zur Sicherheit unserer Reisenden und des Personals des öffentlichen Verkehrs bei.
- Mit polizeilichen Interventionen, auch zusammen mit Partnerorganisationen, übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Sicherheit und Ordnung.
- Zu den spannenden Herausforderungen gehören auch Einsätze in Eventzügen und an Grossanlässen im Einsatzgebiet Schweiz.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist eine dienstleistungsorientierte, offene und gewinnende Persönlichkeit, da du täglich im Kontakt mit unseren Kunden:innen stehst.
- Bei uns ist Teamwork der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in und freust dich auf die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
- Du verfügst über den eidgenössischen Fachausweis Polizist:in I und bringst gute polizeitaktische und -technische Kenntnisse mit.
- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Ausdrucksweise in der deutschen Sprache zeichnen dich aus. Kenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache sind von Vorteil.

descriptionByLocale.it: Agente di polizia: nella polizia dei trasporti 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Agente di polizia presso la base della polizia dei trasporti di San Gallo, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Per la nostra sede di San Gallo cerchiamo agenti di polizia impegnati e motivati ​​che vogliano dedicarsi a un posto entusiasmante e vario. Per noi l’attenzione non è sul lavoro d’ufficio, ma sulla polizia di prossimità, al passo con ciò che accade nel trasporto pubblico, con una chiara attenzione ai compiti della polizia di sicurezza. Collaboriamo regolarmente anche con altre forze di polizia e organizzazioni partner, che amplieranno la tua rete. Entrate a far parte di un team riconoscente, dinamico e motivato che garantisce la sicurezza e l'ordine oltre i confini del cantone. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni riceverete anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Gli altri nostri vantaggi come gli assegni per i figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di agente della Polizia dei trasporti FFS, tu e oltre 190 colleghi garantite la sicurezza, la tranquillità e l'ordine nelle stazioni ferroviarie e sui trasporti pubblici di diverse aziende di trasporto. - Presti una presenza in uniforme e civile sui mezzi di trasporto, nelle stazioni ferroviarie e nei locali delle aziende di trasporto. - Contribuisci alla protezione e alla sicurezza dei nostri viaggiatori e del personale dei trasporti pubblici. - Con gli interventi della polizia, anche insieme alle organizzazioni partner, ti assumi la responsabilità della sicurezza e dell'ordine. - Le sfide entusiasmanti comprendono anche l'impiego nei treni degli eventi e in occasione di grandi eventi nell'area operativa svizzera. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei una personalità orientata al servizio, aperta e vincente, poiché sei a contatto quotidiano con i nostri clienti. - Per noi il lavoro di squadra è la chiave del successo. Sei un giocatore di squadra e non vedi l'ora di lavorare insieme come una squadra. - Possiedi il certificato di ufficiale di polizia federale I e hai buone conoscenze tattiche e tecniche di polizia. - Sei caratterizzato da un'ottima espressione orale e scritta in lingua tedesca. La conoscenza di una seconda lingua nazionale costituisce titolo preferenziale. - Possiedi inoltre buone conoscenze informatiche e amministrative, che puoi utilizzare in modo orientato agli obiettivi. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. descriptionByLocale.en: Police officer: in transport police 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Police officer at the St. Gallen transport police base, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. For our base in St. Gallen, we are looking for committed and motivated police officers who would like to dedicate themselves to an exciting and varied position. For us, the focus is not on office work, but on community policing at the pulse of what is happening in public transport with a clear focus on security police tasks. We also work regularly with other police forces and partner organizations, which will expand your network. Become part of an appreciative, dynamic and motivated team that ensures security and order beyond the canton's borders. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - As a police officer in the SBB transport police, you and over 190 colleagues will ensure safety, peace and order in the train stations and on public transport from various transport companies. - You provide a uniformed and civilian presence in means of transport, in train stations and on the premises of the transport companies. - You contribute to the protection and safety of our travelers and public transport staff. - With police interventions, also together with partner organizations, you take responsibility for security and order. - The exciting challenges also include deployments in event trains and at major events in the Swiss operational area. This is what you bring with you. - You are a service-oriented, open and winning personality, as you are in daily contact with our customers. - For us, teamwork is the key to success. You are a team player and look forward to working together as a team. - You have the federal police officer I certificate and have good police tactical and technical knowledge. - You are characterized by very good oral and written expression in the German language. Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. - You also have good IT and administrative knowledge, which you can use in a goal-oriented manner. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level H, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Officier de police à la base de la police des transports de Winterthur, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir.
